The Aurora, Texas, UFO incident reportedly occurred on April 17, 1897, when, according to locals, a UFO crashed on a farm near Aurora, Texas.
The pilot was "not of this world" and was said to be an alien.
Reportedly, wreckage from the crash site was dumped into a nearby well located under the damaged windmill, while some ended up with the pilot's body in the grave.
The hoax theory is primarily based on a 1980 Time magazine interview with Etta Pegues, an 86-year-old Aurora resident who claimed that Haydon had fabricated the entire story
